name: Panel Populator
description: Create a PanelPopulator from a panel and a list of agents.

inputParameters.name: agents
inputParameters.description: List of PopulatorAgents. Bound feature agents are only used if their feature belongs to this panel.

inputParameters.name: standard_beam_width
inputParameters.description: Default width for every beam category an agent does not set explicitly.

inputParameters.name: default_feature_configs
inputParameters.description: List of unbound FeatureAgent prototypes (one per feature type), applied to every panel feature no other agent handles.

inputParameters.name: joint_rule_overrides
inputParameters.description: List of panel-level joint rules (CategoryRule / CompositeRule). Tried on a cluster only after the owning agents' own rules fail, as a panel-wide fallback.

inputParameters.name: max_distance
inputParameters.description: Maximum gap distance applied to all joint finding and creation. None -> 0.1.

outputParameters.name: populator
outputParameters.description: PanelPopulator ready to run. Connect to CT_Populate_Model.
